title: Quick Steamed Polish Vegetable Wrap
description: A solo dinner dish featuring creme fraiche and steamed vegetables wrapped in leaves, perfect for spring. This ovo-vegetarian friendly dish is a great way to enjoy the flavors of Poland.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and reduce the heat to a simmer.
Prepare the collard green leaves by blanching them in the simmering water for 30 seconds.
Shock the leaves in an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
In a bowl, mix together the creme fraiche, grated carrot, sliced zucchini, chopped scallions, and chopped dill.
Add the sliced hard-boiled egg to the bowl and stir gently.
Season the mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
To assemble the wraps, lay a blanched collard green leaf flat and spoon some of the vegetable mixture onto the center of the leaf.
Fold the stem end over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining leaves and filling.
Steam the wraps over boiling water for 5 minutes, covered with a lid.
